LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.title: 對話 · Dialogue
LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_ONE.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东賢，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that after only two years, you are already a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计画？
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.english: Director? You look so handsome, are tall enough, and act well in every role; how regrettable it would be if you didn't become an actor! Besides, audiences highly recognize your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

LESSON_ONE_DIALOGUE_TWO.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

text.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
text.simplified: 东賢从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位着名的导演。
text.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

text.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
text.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东賢高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
text.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

text.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
text.simplified: 起初，东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
text.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

text.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
text.simplified: 但东賢拿出自己的计画书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
text.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
text.simplified: 到了台湾后，东賢一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

text.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
text.simplified: 东賢说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
text.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'

LESSON_ONE_PART_ONE.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Predicate

items.question: Can 可以說是 mean physical ability to speak?
items.answer: No. 可以說是 means 'practically / you could say'; use 可以說 without 是 for ability or permission to speak.

right.pinyin: Wǒ kěyǐ shuō yí jù zhōngwén.
right.english: I can speak a sentence of Chinese.

items.question: Does 可以說是 replace normal 是 in direct facts?
items.answer: Use 可以說是 to soften a description or summarize; use ordinary 是 for direct factual identities.

right.english: He really is my older brother.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí ō, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I'm a fan of yours, quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù mǎn shíbā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yí ge dàrén le.
text.english: He will turn eighteen next month; you could say he is an adult now.

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhèlǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì èr ge jiā.
text.english: I have lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; this place can be called my second home.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 小王在學校很受歡迎，成績好又會彈吉他，大家常說他是學校的明星人物。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express feelings that exceed expectations using 多麼…啊.
grammarPages.explanation: This construction indicates an exclamation when something exceeds one's expectations. In casual speech, 麼 can be dropped (多…啊).

items.question: Can 多麼 ask for quantity or cost?
items.answer: No. 多麼 is exclusively an exclamation of degree ('how...!'); use 多少 to ask for prices or quantities.

items.question: Does 多麼 modify a noun directly?
items.answer: 多麼 modifies adjectives/stative verbs, not bare nouns; say 多麼好 instead of 多麼人.

right.pinyin: Tā shì duóme hǎo de rén a!
right.english: What a wonderful person he is!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a!
text.english: You are so good-looking; how regrettable it would be if you didn't become an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dàdà de, ěrduo chángcháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog has big eyes and long ears; how cute it is!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒ bīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's scorching outside; eating mango ice while watching TV at home, how comfortable!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 多麼…啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 看到滿山盛開的櫻花，大家忍不住讚嘆：這裡風景___美麗啊！

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the preceding sentence with an additional reason.

items.question: Can 再說 alone mean 'say it again'?
items.answer: As a conjunction adding reasons, 再說 introduces a clause; to ask someone to repeat, say 請再說一次.

right.pinyin: Qǐng zài shuō yí cì, wǒ méi tīngdǒng.
right.english: Please say it once again, I didn't understand.

items.question: Where does conjunction 再說 sit in the sentence?
items.answer: 再說 sits at the beginning of the reinforcing clause, never at the very end.

right.traditional: 我不想去，再說我也沒有錢。
right.simplified: 我不想去，再说我也没有钱。
right.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, zàishuō wǒ yě méiyǒu qián.
right.english: I don't want to go; besides, I have no money.

text.traditional: 不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Bù dāng yǎnyuán duōme kěxī a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: How regrettable if you don't become an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qīmòkǎo le, xià xīngqī de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have to hand in two reports recently; moreover, final exams are coming, so I won't go on the trip next week.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己。
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己。
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāodào bù shǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ.
text.english: Joining clubs lets you make friends; furthermore, it helps us understand ourselves better.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 再說 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老闆什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Connect two clauses showing causal result or contrast using 而.
grammarPages.explanation: 而 connects two clauses, often indicating a transition, contrast, or cause-and-effect relationship in formal writing.

items.question: Can 而 connect two nouns like 和?
items.answer: No. 而 connects two clauses or verb phrases; use 和 or 跟 to connect nouns.

right.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi píngguǒ hé xiāngjiāo.
right.english: I want to buy apples and bananas.

items.question: Where is 而 placed between two clauses?
items.answer: 而 stands before the second verb or predicate clause, not before the subject.
items.wrongTraditional: 他很聰明，而大家都喜歡他。
items.wrongSimplified: 他很聪明，而大家都喜欢他。

right.english: He is smart and also kind.

text.traditional: 東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定。
text.simplified: 东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián de fùmǔ yīnwèi dānxīn tā de wèilái ér fǎnduì zhège juédìng.
text.english: Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bù shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bāndào le xiāngxià, guò zhe jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he couldn't adapt to the stressful city life, he moved to the countryside and lives a simple life.

text.traditional: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重視內心的平靜與快樂。
text.simplified: 有些人追求名利，而有些人更重视内心的平静与快乐。
text.pinyin: Yǒuxiē rén zhuīqiú mínglì, ér yǒuxiē rén gèng zhòngshì nèixīn de píngjìng yǔ kuàilè.
text.english: Some people pursue fame and fortune, whereas some value inner peace and happiness more.

questions.prompt: 哥哥因為工作認真有實力，___獲得了升職的機會。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express producing a new creation or result through an action using V出.
grammarPages.explanation: When 出 follows a verb here, it indicates that a new item or creative result is produced through the action (e.g. 寫出, 畫出, 做不出).

items.question: Does V出 mean physical movement out of a place?
items.answer: V出 here emphasizes creating or bringing an idea into reality (想出, 寫出); physical emergence uses 走出來.

right.pinyin: Tā cóng fángjiān zǒu chūlái le.
right.english: He walked out from the room.

items.question: Can any verb take 出 to mean production?
items.answer: Only verbs of creation or cognition take productive 出 (想出, 做出, 畫出, 寫出).

right.pinyin: Tā huà chū le yì zhāng huà.

text.traditional: 只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。
text.simplified: 只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。
text.pinyin: Zhǐyào búduàn nǔlì, jiù yídìng néng huà chū jīngcǎi de rénshēng.
text.english: As long as you strive continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐ'ài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote a novel that everyone loved very much.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bù chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I have learned baking cakes for a long time, but still cannot produce a cake that satisfies myself.

grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.

questions.prompt: 經過大家熱烈的討論，我們終於想___了解決問題的辦法。

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Give an exemplar or reference a type of person/thing using 像…這樣子.
grammarPages.explanation: 像…這樣子 points to a specific example or type of person/situation, often followed by a comment or evaluation.
grammarPages.pattern: 像 + Noun / Clause + 這樣子 + Comment

complement.traditional: 這樣子的人很有責任感。
complement.simplified: 这样子的人很有责任感。

items.question: Can 像…這樣子 stand without an example inside?
items.answer: 像…這樣子 frames an example; the example or role must sit between 像 and 這樣子.

right.pinyin: Xiàng tā zhèyàngzi de rén hěn hǎo.
right.english: People like him are very good.

items.question: Does 這樣子 replace ordinary 這樣?
items.answer: 這樣子 sounds more conversational and vivid; both point to a manner or type of person.

text.traditional: 小簡是一個有愛心、有禮貌的人，像這樣子的男人你要好好把握啊！
text.simplified: 小简是一个有爱心、有礼貌的人，像这样子的男人你要好好把握啊！
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn shì yí ge yǒu àixīn, yǒu lǐmào de rén, xiàng zhèyàngzi de nánrén nǐ yào hǎohǎo bǎwò a!
text.english: Xiao Jian is caring and polite; a man like this, you should really hold on to him!

text.traditional: 像每天加班到深夜這樣子，身體早晚會吃不消的。
text.simplified: 像每天加班到深夜这样子，身体早晚会吃不消的。
text.pinyin: Xiàng měitiān jiābān dào shēnyè zhèyàngzi, shēntǐ zǎowǎn huì chībùxiāo de.
text.english: Living like this, working overtime late every night, the body won't be able to take it sooner or later.

text.traditional: 像他這樣子有實力又肯努力的演員，一定能成功的。
text.simplified: 像他这样子有实力又肯努力的演员，一定能成功的。
text.pinyin: Xiàng tā zhèyàngzi yǒu shílì yòu kěn nǔlì de yǎnyuán, yídìng néng chénggōng de.
text.english: An actor like this who has talent and is willing to work hard is bound to succeed.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 電影是許多人生活中的休閒娛樂，但是要把一部電影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.simplified: 电影是许多人生活中的休闲娱乐，但是要把一部电影拍好，可不是一件容易的事。
text.english: Movies are leisure entertainment in many people's lives, but making a good movie is by no means an easy task.

text.traditional: 東賢從小就對電影很有興趣，常常夢想自己能成為一位著名的導演。
text.simplified: 东賢从小就对电影很有兴趣，常常梦想自己能成为一位着名的导演。
text.english: Ever since childhood, Dongxian has been very interested in movies, often dreaming of becoming a famous director.

text.traditional: 為了追求這個夢想，東賢高中畢業後就決定到臺灣學習中文和電影製作。
text.simplified: 为了追求这个梦想，东賢高中毕业后就决定到台湾学习中文和电影制作。
text.english: In pursuit of this dream, after graduating from high school Dongxian decided to go to Taiwan to learn Chinese and filmmaking.

text.traditional: 起初，東賢的父母因為擔心他的未來而反對這個決定，希望他能留在韓國念商學。
text.simplified: 起初，东賢的父母因为担心他的未来而反对这个决定，希望他能留在韩国念商学。
text.english: Initially, Dongxian's parents opposed this decision because they worried about his future, hoping he would stay in Korea to study business.

text.traditional: 但東賢拿出自己的計畫書，向父母保證自己一定會認真學習、照顧好自己。
text.simplified: 但东賢拿出自己的计画书，向父母保证自己一定会认真学习、照顾好自己。
text.english: However, Dongxian presented his plan and guaranteed to his parents that he would study earnestly and take good care of himself.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣後，東賢一邊在大學念書，一邊在電影劇組實習，生活雖然忙碌但非常充實。
text.simplified: 到了台湾后，东賢一边在大学念书，一边在电影剧组实习，生活虽然忙碌但非常充实。
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian studied at university while interning on film sets; life was busy yet very fulfilling.

text.traditional: 東賢說：「追求夢想就像畫一張美麗的圖畫，只要不斷努力，就一定能畫出精彩的人生。」
text.simplified: 东賢说：「追求梦想就像画一张美丽的图画，只要不断努力，就一定能画出精彩的人生。」
text.english: Dongxian said: 'Pursuing a dream is like drawing a beautiful picture; as long as you work continuously, you will definitely paint a splendid life.'
